CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_engagement_cancellation_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if old.status='cancelled' and new.status is distinct from old.status then
    raise exception 'A cancelled Shift cannot be reopened.';
  end if;
  if new.status='cancelled' and old.status is distinct from 'cancelled'
     and not exists(select 1 from public.work_assignment_cancellations c
       where c.assignment_id=new.assignment_id) then
    raise exception 'A Shift cancellation requires an audit record.';
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.prevent_assignment_cancellation_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'Shift cancellation audit records are immutable.'; end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.prevent_engagement_closure_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'Finalized Job Engagement closures are immutable.'; end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_company_jobs(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users u
    join public.company_memberships cm
      on cm.user_id = u.user_id
    join public.companies c
      on c.company_id = cm.company_id
    where u.user_id = auth.uid()
      and u.role = 'employer'::public.user_role
      and u.status = 'active'::public.account_status
      and cm.company_id = p_company_id
      and cm.member_role in ('owner', 'employer')
      and c.verification_status = 'verified'::public.verification_status
  );
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_company_engagement_closure_requests()
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, application_id uuid, company_id uuid, job_title text, worker_name text, request_reason text, status text, requested_at timestamp with time zone, processed_by uuid, processed_at timestamp with time zone, response_reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select r.request_id,r.application_id,j.company_id,j.title::text,u.name::text,
    r.request_reason,r.status,r.requested_at,r.processed_by,r.processed_at,r.response_reason
  from public.job_engagement_closure_requests r
  join public.job_applications a on a.application_id=r.application_id
  join public.job_postings j on j.job_id=a.job_id
  join public.users u on u.user_id=r.worker_id
  where public.can_manage_company_jobs(j.company_id) is true
  order by r.requested_at desc,r.request_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_company_work_assignments(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(assignment_id uuid, application_id uuid, job_id uuid, job_title text, worker_id uuid, scheduled_start timestamp with time zone, scheduled_end timestamp with time zone, workplace_location text, assignment_status text, verification_status text, check_in_at timestamp with time zone, check_out_at timestamp with time zone, verified_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    IF p_company_id IS NULL
       OR NOT public.can_manage_company_jobs(p_company_id)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized to view company assignments';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        a.assignment_id,
        a.application_id,
        a.job_id,
        j.title::text,
        a.worker_id,
        a.scheduled_start,
        a.scheduled_end,
        a.workplace_location,
        a.status::text,
        a.verification_status::text,
        att.check_in_at,
        att.check_out_at,
        a.verified_at
    FROM public.work_assignments a
    JOIN public.job_postings j
      ON j.job_id = a.job_id
    LEFT JOIN public.work_attendance att
      ON att.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
    WHERE a.company_id = p_company_id
    ORDER BY a.scheduled_start DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_work_assignments()
 RETURNS TABLE(assignment_id uuid, application_id uuid, job_id uuid, job_title text, company_id uuid, company_name text, scheduled_start timestamp with time zone, scheduled_end timestamp with time zone, workplace_location text, assignment_status text, verification_status text, check_in_at timestamp with time zone, check_out_at timestamp with time zone, verified_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        a.assignment_id,
        a.application_id,
        a.job_id,
        j.title::text,
        a.company_id,
        c.company_name::text,
        a.scheduled_start,
        a.scheduled_end,
        a.workplace_location,
        a.status::text,
        a.verification_status::text,
        att.check_in_at,
        att.check_out_at,
        a.verified_at
    FROM public.work_assignments a
    JOIN public.job_postings j
      ON j.job_id = a.job_id
    JOIN public.companies c
      ON c.company_id = a.company_id
    LEFT JOIN public.work_attendance att
      ON att.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
    WHERE a.worker_id = auth.uid()
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.users u
          WHERE u.user_id = auth.uid()
            AND u.role = 'job_seeker'
            AND u.status = 'active'
      )
    ORDER BY a.scheduled_start DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_work_assignment(p_assignment_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_assignment public.work_assignments%ROWTYPE;
    v_latest_round integer;
    v_expected_files integer;
    v_recorded_files bigint;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_assignment
    FROM public.work_assignments
    WHERE assignment_id = p_assignment_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assignment not found';
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.can_manage_company_jobs(v_assignment.company_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized to verify this assignment';
    END IF;

    IF v_assignment.status <> 'awaiting_verification'
       OR v_assignment.verification_status <> 'pending_review'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assignment is not pending verification';
    END IF;

    -- Both attendance timestamps must exist.
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.work_attendance
        WHERE assignment_id = p_assignment_id
          AND check_in_at IS NOT NULL
          AND check_out_at IS NOT NULL
          AND check_out_at >= check_in_at
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completed attendance is required';
    END IF;

    -- Identify the most recent evidence submission.
    SELECT submission_round, file_count
    INTO v_latest_round, v_expected_files
    FROM public.work_evidence_submissions
    WHERE assignment_id = p_assignment_id
    ORDER BY submission_round DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Work evidence has not been submitted';
    END IF;

    -- Confirm that the latest submission has 1–5 recorded files.
    SELECT count(*)
    INTO v_recorded_files
    FROM public.work_evidence
    WHERE assignment_id = p_assignment_id
      AND submission_round = v_latest_round;

    IF v_recorded_files <> v_expected_files
       OR v_recorded_files NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evidence file records are incomplete';
    END IF;

    -- Confirm that every recorded file in the latest submission
    -- still exists in the private Storage bucket.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.work_evidence e
        WHERE e.assignment_id = p_assignment_id
        AND e.submission_round = v_latest_round
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM storage.objects o
            WHERE o.bucket_id = 'work-evidence'
                AND o.name = e.storage_path
                AND o.owner_id = e.submitted_by::text
        )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'One or more evidence files are missing from private storage';
    END IF;
    -- Mark the shift as completed and verified.
    UPDATE public.work_assignments
    SET status = 'completed',
        verification_status = 'verified',
        verified_at = clock_timestamp(),
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE assignment_id = p_assignment_id;

    -- Preserve the employer's verification decision.
    INSERT INTO public.work_verification_history (
        assignment_id,
        action,
        previous_status,
        new_status,
        performed_by,
        note
    )
    VALUES (
        p_assignment_id,
        'verified',
        'pending_review',
        'verified',
        auth.uid(),
        'Work verified by employer'
    );
END;
$function$
